attacker[active]

// ============================================================
// Model 4A:
// Responder key confirmation through tau_B.
//
// Inputs established by Model 3:
// - transcript is the common authenticated transcript T;
// - kcb is the confidential responder-confirmation key K_B^c.
//
// This model verifies that A reaches the responder-confirmed
// state only after receiving a valid tag generated by B.
// ============================================================

principal A[
    knows public transcript
    knows public bconfirm_tag

    // Shared confirmation key derived from HKDF.
    knows private kcb
]

principal B[
    knows public transcript
    knows public bconfirm_tag

    // Same HKDF-derived confirmation key.
    knows private kcb

    // Enc(B-CONFIRM, T) abstraction.
    confirm_data_b = HASH(bconfirm_tag, transcript)

    // tau_B = HMAC_{K_B^c}(Enc(B-CONFIRM, T))
    tau_b = MAC(kcb, confirm_data_b)
]

principal Sink[
    knows public sink_tag
]

// tau_b is visible and attacker-mutable in transit.
B -> A: tau_b

principal A[
    // Independently reconstruct the expected confirmation tag.
    confirm_data_a = HASH(bconfirm_tag, transcript)
    tau_b_expected = MAC(kcb, confirm_data_a)

    // Continue only if B possesses the same K_B^c
    // and uses the same transcript.
    _ = ASSERT(tau_b, tau_b_expected)?

    // Fresh acceptance event after successful verification.
    generates responder_marker
    responder_confirmed = HASH(responder_marker)
]

A -> Sink: [responder_confirmed]

principal Sink[
    use_responder_confirmed = HASH(responder_confirmed)
]

queries[
    confidentiality? kcb

    authentication? B -> A: tau_b[
        precondition[A -> Sink: responder_confirmed]
    ]
]
